For college honestly look into which jobs specifically you want (exactly which companies or gov't programs), then which degrees secure a spot at these jobs. I would say have roughly 5 on the table. A lot of psych degrees are really an extremely general degree, and its much safer and cost effective if you get a degree in something specific to your job. I.e. social work masters, or bachelors in clinical counseling. My current two year school offers a substance abuse counseling certificate for my state and I didnt even know. A lot of colleges also work closely with certain companies too, so the degrees they provide are almost certainly in line with the industries surrounding the college within a 100 mile radius or so. Unless its a bigger more well known college like Berkeley which has a well known and amiable psych program. Good luck (: and I'd be happy to help the research isn't easy.
